zh.title: 長榮航空獲七項永續獎並加入 IATA 採購計畫，華航首獲職安領袖獎
zh.summary: 長榮航空和中華航空在臺灣永續獎頒獎典禮分獲七項、六項肯定。長榮航空並宣布簽約加入國際航空運輸協會的永續採購計畫。
body: 臺灣永續能源研究基金會 11 月 25 日舉辦頒獎典禮。長榮航空獲七項獎，包括首度取得全球企業永續獎的永續報告書金獎，以及臺灣企業永續獎的永續報告書白金獎。
長榮航空表示，今年已簽約加入國際航空運輸協會（IATA）的永續採購計畫，是臺灣首家參與的航空公司。
中華航空獲六項獎，首次獲頒職業安全領袖獎。華航也表示，永續報告書在全球企業永續獎獲金級肯定。

en.title: EVA Air wins seven sustainability awards as China Airlines earns its first occupational safety award
en.summary: EVA Air and China Airlines received seven and six sustainability awards, respectively. EVA Air also announced that it had joined IATA’s Sustainable Procurement program.
body: EVA Air received seven awards at the Taiwan Institute for Sustainable Energy’s ceremony on November 25. They included its first Global Corporate Sustainability Awards gold for sustainability reporting and a Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Awards platinum for its report.
EVA Air said it signed up for the International Air Transport Association’s Sustainable Procurement program this year, becoming the first Taiwanese airline to join.

China Airlines received six awards, including its first Occupational Safety Leadership Award. The carrier also said its sustainability report received gold at the Global Corporate Sustainability Awards.
